about.title: About us
about.intro: We create journeys across Kyrgyzstan where you can feel the character of the mountains, discover the beauty of the lakes and meet local culture.
about.homeTitle: Only mountains can be better than mountains
about.homeIntro: Beautiful places, mountain routes and experiences that stay with you.
about.storyTitle: We show Kyrgyzstan the way locals know it
about.storyFirst: Meet KHAN TENGRI. We are a team creating journeys around the beautiful Issyk-Kul.
about.storySecond: For us, a tour is more than a trip from point A to point B. It is new emotions, beautiful places, good company and memories you want to return to.
about.storyThird: We invite you to places where the mountains meet the sky. Explore Issyk-Kul with KHAN TENGRI and discover places you will want to see with your own eyes.
about.statExperienceLabel: years of experience among our senior guides
about.storyClosing: KHAN TENGRI — where the mountains meet the lake.
about.localText: We help you choose a destination and route, from lakeside trips to mountain adventures.
about.careText: We support our guests at every stage and explain in advance what to bring and what to expect.
about.impressionsText: We want each journey to be more than a route: a lasting memory of Kyrgyzstan.
about.teamText: Our team brings together people who love their home and are happy to share its beauty with our guests.
